'''Runner''' was a genetic [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]], commenced during the [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]]. He was born on an [[Frozen moon|unnamed frozen moon]] alongside several other clones located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Runner was one of the most devout of the clones' leader, [[Seer (clone)|Seer]].

In [[41 ABY]], when the clones finally escaped from the moon that they had all been trapped on for years, Runner, alongside nearly all of the other clones save for [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], began suffering from an illness that Seer promised would be cured by the entity known as [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]. Runner died during the voyage to Mother when he got into a fight with [[Nyss Nenn]].
